summary: Completed testing of 'What to Do Next' feature for job applications. Fixed critical backend bug (wrong LLM import), all 15 backend tests pass, frontend component fully functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: ImportError in server.py lines 5155 and 5225 - was using 'chat' instead of 'LlmChat' from emergentintegrations.llm.chat module
seed_data_creation: Test users, sessions, profiles, and applications created via mongosh and cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Next Steps feature is fully functional. Key endpoints: GET /api/applications/{id}/next-steps (returns steps with progress), PUT /api/applications/{id}/next-steps (updates step completion), POST /api/applications/{id}/next-steps/generate (AI generates outreach messages and interview questions via GPT-5.2). NextStepsCard component only renders for status='applied' applications. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_next_steps.py
verified_features: GET /api/applications/{id}/next-steps returns default 6-step structure with progress tracking
PUT /api/applications/{id}/next-steps updates individual step completion status
PUT handles track_outcome with outcome values (pending, interview_scheduled, rejected, offer)
POST /api/applications/{id}/next-steps/generate creates AI outreach messages (linkedin_message, email, connection_request)
POST /api/applications/{id}/next-steps/generate creates AI interview prep questions
POST returns 400 for unsupported steps (only send_message and prep_interview supported)
Generated content persists in database and is returned in subsequent GET calls
NextStepsCard component renders only for 'applied' status applications
Progress bar shows correct completion percentage (0/6 to 6/6)
Checkboxes toggle step completion with toast notifications
Generate Message button creates personalized AI content with dialog popup
Generate Questions button creates interview prep Q&A
Track Outcome dropdown updates application outcome
Set 7-Day Reminder button saves follow-up date

categories: TestGetNextSteps (3 tests) - default structure, auth required, 404 handling
TestUpdateNextSteps (5 tests) - completion status, progress calculation, outcome, reminder, validation
TestGenerateNextStepContent (6 tests) - outreach message, interview questions, email, connection request, persistence, validation
TestNextStepsIntegration (1 test) - full workflow from create to verify

tests_performed: Progress updates after checkbox click (toast shown)
Generate Message button creates AI content
Generated content dialog displays with Copy to Clipboard option

bug_fixed.root_cause: ImportError in generate_outreach_message and generate_interview_questions functions - code was trying to import 'chat' function but correct import is 'LlmChat' class from emergentintegrations.llm.chat module
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Changed 'from emergentintegrations.llm.chat import chat, UserMessage' to 'from emergentintegrations.llm.chat import LlmChat, UserMessage' and updated function calls to use LlmChat class pattern with send_message method
